body:
Codex names its default (`defaultReasoningEffort` in `model/list`, kept as the model's `effort` by `agents.rs::codex_page`). The models endpoint names only which effort levels a Claude model supports, never its default, so the Claude presets, the aliases and the discovered ids carry no `effort`: the pick's first option reads "Default" and `board.rs::spawn_agent` passes no `--effort`, leaving the effort to Claude Code.

- Give every native model an `effort`: the effort its agent reports, else `medium` when the model offers it, else the middle of the efforts it offers. Custom runners (`run` argv) take none, and a `[[models]]` entry's own `effort` still wins.
- A run with no chosen effort then passes the model's `effort`, so a run's recorded effort is never blank, and the pick's first option reads "Default (medium)" — `solace_task.agent_pick` already shows the model's `effort` in that option, so no client change.
- Spec 15 §6 and the README's Models section say the default comes from the agent, and `medium` stands behind it.
title: agents: a default effort for every model
